<!doctype html>
<html lang="pt-BR">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<title>Galo Pacífico - As Cinco Fases (novo design)</title>
<style>
  html,body{margin:0;height:100%;background:#070a12;color:#dfe7ff;font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;overflow:hidden}
  #wrap{height:100%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-direction:column;gap:10px}
  canvas{width:min(96vw,1024px);height:auto;aspect-ratio:854/480;image-rendering:pixelated;background:#0d1220;border:3px solid #2b3a5c;box-shadow:0 0 40px #0008;outline:none}
  #hint{font-size:12px;color:#7f8bad;letter-spacing:.04em}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div id="wrap">
  <canvas id="game" width="854" height="480" tabindex="0"></canvas>
  <div id="hint">Clique no jogo para focar &bull; A/D mover &bull; W pular &bull; ESPAÇO atacar &bull; ENTER avançar</div>
</div>
<script>
"use strict";
const IMAGES = {"fundo":"data:image/png;base64,","plataforma":"data:image/png;base64,","cheio":"data:image/png;base64,iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAABgAAAAWCAYAAADafVyIAAAAY0lEQVR4Ae3B0Q2DQAxEwbfu0x24nOvgCt38RggEJHJ0kZjhsS5nmYucZZbhLPMhZ5lfExvOMl/QHOJN0CxoFjQLmgXNxAFnmRs0h9gRNAuaiQucZXZoDnEiWImz7CxzQ/DvXgBvHMB8i90cAAAAAElFTkSuQmCC","vazio":"data:image/png;base64,iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAABgAAAAWCAYAAADafVyIAAAAaUlEQVR4Ae3BwQ0CMQxFwWe35cNvwaWmhRxSl7kitIhdkFGQmOFvX6EsTgplsY1QFm8KZfFtxoNQFh9Ycxh3nGZOM6eZ08xpZjwRyuKCNYdxwGnmNDNOCGVxYM1hvODsJJQVyuIC59fdAL+/Fsx7aZCrAAAAAElFTkSuQmCC","player_idle_0":"data:image/png;base64,","player_idle_1":"data:image/png;base64,","player_run_0":"data:image/png;base64,","player_run_1":"data:image/png;base64,","player_run_2":"data:image/png;base64,","player_run_3":"data:image/png;base64,","player_jump_0":"data:image/png;base64,","player_attack_0":"data:image/png;base64,","player_attack_1":"data:image/png;base64,","player_hurt_0":"data:image/png;base64,","player_hurt_1":"data:image/png;base64,","player_die_0":"data:image/png;base64,","player_die_1":"data:image/png;base64,","player_die_2":"data:image/png;base64,","boss1_idle_0":"data:image/png;base64,","boss1_idle_1":"data:image/png;base64,","boss1_idle_2":"data:image/png;base64,","boss1_idle_3":"data:image/png;base64,","boss1_walk_0":"data:image/png;base64,","boss1_walk_1":"data:image/png;base64,","boss1_walk_2":"data:image/png;base64,","boss1_walk_3":"data:image/png;base64,","boss1_hurt_0":"data:image/png;base64,","boss1_hurt_1":"data:image/png;base64,","boss1_death_0":"data:image/png;base64,","boss1_death_1":"data:image/png;base64,","boss1_death_2":"data:image/png;base64,","boss2_idle_0":"data:image/png;base64,","boss2_idle_1":"data:image/png;base64,","boss2_idle_2":"data:image/png;base64,","boss2_idle_3":"data:image/png;base64,","boss2_walk_0":"data:image/png;base64,","boss2_walk_1":"data:image/png;base64,","boss2_walk_2":"data:image/png;base64,","boss2_walk_3":"data:image/png;base64,","boss2_hurt_0":"data:image/png;base64,","boss2_hurt_1":"data:image/png;base64,","boss2_death_0":"data:image/png;base64,","boss2_death_1":"data:image/png;base64,","boss2_death_2":"data:image/png;base64,","boss3_idle_0":"data:image/png;base64,","boss3_idle_1":"data:image/png;base64,","boss3_idle_2":"data:image/png;base64,","boss3_idle_3":"data:image/png;base64,","boss3_walk_0":"data:image/png;base64,","boss3_walk_1":"data:image/png;base64,","boss3_walk_2":"data:image/png;base64,","boss3_walk_3":"data:image/png;base64,","boss3_hurt_0":"data:image/png;base64,","boss3_hurt_1":"data:image/png;base64,","boss3_death_0":"data:image/png;base64,","boss3_death_1":"data:image/png;base64,","boss3_death_2":"data:image/png;base64,","boss4_idle_0":"data:image/png;base64,","boss4_idle_1":"data:image/png;base64,","boss4_idle_2":"data:image/png;base64,","boss4_idle_3":"data:image/png;base64,","boss4_walk_0":"data:image/png;base64,","boss4_walk_1":"data:image/png;base64,","boss4_walk_2":"data:image/png;base64,","boss4_walk_3":"data:image/png;base64,","boss4_hurt_0":"data:image/png;base64,","boss4_hurt_1":"data:image/png;base64,","boss4_death_0":"data:image/png;base64,","boss4_death_1":"data:image/png;base64,","boss4_death_2":"data:image/png;base64,","boss5_idle_0":"data:image/png;base64,","boss5_idle_1":"data:image/png;base64,","boss5_idle_2":"data:image/png;base64,","boss5_idle_3":"data:image/png;base64,","boss5_walk_0":"data:image/png;base64,","boss5_walk_1":"data:image/png;base64,","boss5_walk_2":"data:image/png;base64,","boss5_walk_3":"data:image/png;base64,","boss5_hurt_0":"data:image/png;base64,","boss5_hurt_1":"data:image/png;base64,","boss5_death_0":"data:image/png;base64,","boss5_death_1":"data:image/png;base64,","boss5_death_2":"data:image/png;base64,"};
const SOUNDS = {"Ataque":"data:audio/webm;codecs=opus;base64,","BossAcerto":"data:audio/webm;codecs=opus;base64,","BossMorte":"data:audio/webm;codecs=opus;base64,","Derrota":"data:audio/webm;codecs=opus;base64,","JogadorDano":"data:audio/webm;codecs=opus;base64,","Menu":"data:audio/webm;codecs=opus;base64,","Musica":"data:audio/webm;codecs=opus;base64,","Vitoria":"data:audio/webm;codecs=opus;base64,"};
const C = document.getElementById("game");
const ctx = C.getContext("2d");
ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled = false;
function img(k){ const i=new Image(); i.src=IMAGES[k]; return i; }
const A={}; for(const k in IMAGES) A[k]=img(k);
function playSom(n,v){ try{const a=new Audio(SOUNDS[n]);a.volume=v==null?.65:v;a.play().catch(()=>{});}catch(e){} }
let musica=null;
function startMusica(){ if(musica)return; try{musica=new Audio(SOUNDS.Musica);musica.loop=true;musica.volume=.22;musica.play().catch(()=>{});}catch(e){} }

const PANIM={
  idle:{keys:["player_idle_0","player_idle_1"],fps:6,loop:true},
  run:{keys:["player_run_0","player_run_1","player_run_2","player_run_3"],fps:12,loop:true},
  jump:{keys:["player_jump_0"],fps:5,loop:false},
  attack:{keys:["player_attack_0","player_attack_1"],fps:10,loop:false},
  hurt:{keys:["player_hurt_0","player_hurt_1"],fps:10,loop:false},
  die:{keys:["player_die_0","player_die_1","player_die_2"],fps:5,loop:false},
};
const BOSSES=[
  {obj:"boss1",nome:"Slime Real",scale:1.5,w:144,h:132,y:424,vel:38,anims:["idle","walk","hurt","death"]},
  {obj:"boss2",nome:"Cavaleiro Cinzento",scale:1.4,w:146,h:157,y:424,vel:54,anims:["idle","walk","hurt","death"]},
  {obj:"boss3",nome:"Dragão de Fogo",scale:1.3,w:187,h:135,y:424,vel:46,anims:["idle","walk","hurt","death"]},
  {obj:"boss4",nome:"Rainha Aranha",scale:1.3,w:166,h:146,y:424,vel:60,anims:["idle","walk","hurt","death"]},
  {obj:"boss5",nome:"Olho Cósmico",scale:1.4,w:157,h:157,y:424,vel:42,anims:["idle","walk","hurt","death"]},
];
const BG=["#173e34","#1c2b52","#4a2a1c","#412044","#252a3a"];
const S={screen:"start",phase:1,hp:3,bossHp:10,t:0,paused:false,invuln:0,dead:0,victory:0,victorySom:false,flash:0,attack:0,attackAge:0,attackId:0,lastHit:-1,bossAnim:"idle",bossFrame:0,bossFrameT:0,player:{x:95,y:424,vx:0,vy:0,onGround:true,face:1,anim:"idle",frame:0,frameT:0},boss:{x:680,y:424}};
const keys={},prev={};
function down(k){return !!keys[k];} function pressed(k){return !!keys[k]&&!prev[k];}
function clamp(v,a,b){return Math.max(a,Math.min(b,v));} function cfg(){return BOSSES[S.phase-1];}
function bossKeys(){const out=[];for(let i=0;i<10;i++){const k=cfg().obj+"_"+S.bossAnim+"_"+i;if(IMAGES[k])out.push(k);else break;}return out;}
function setBossAnim(n){if(cfg().anims.indexOf(n)<0)return;if(S.bossAnim!==n){S.bossAnim=n;S.bossFrame=0;S.bossFrameT=0;}}
function updateBossAnim(dt){const k=bossKeys();if(!k.length)return;S.bossFrameT+=dt;if(S.bossFrameT>=1/9){S.bossFrameT-=1/9;S.bossFrame++;if(S.bossFrame>=k.length)S.bossFrame=k.length-1;}}
function platforms(){const p=[{x:0,y:424,w:854,h:56},{x:92+(S.phase%2)*35,y:323,w:175,h:24},{x:562-(S.phase%2)*25,y:263,w:175,h:24}];if(S.phase>=3)p.push({x:345,y:193,w:150,h:24});return p;}
function resetPhase(){S.hp=3;S.bossHp=10;S.invuln=0;S.dead=0;S.victory=0;S.victorySom=false;S.flash=0;S.attack=0;S.attackAge=0;S.attackId=0;S.lastHit=-1;S.bossAnim="idle";S.bossFrame=0;S.bossFrameT=0;const p=S.player;p.x=95;p.y=424;p.vx=0;p.vy=0;p.onGround=true;p.anim="idle";p.frame=0;p.frameT=0;S.boss.x=680;S.boss.y=cfg().y;}
function setAnim(n,r){const p=S.player;if(p.anim!==n||r){p.anim=n;p.frame=0;p.frameT=0;}}
function overlap(padX,padY){const p=S.player,b=cfg(),bw=b.w*.6,bh=b.h*.6,px=p.x,py=p.y-35;return !(px+24+padX<S.boss.x-bw/2||px-24-padX>S.boss.x+bw/2||py+35+padY<S.boss.y-bh||py-padY>S.boss.y);}
function damage(){if(S.invuln>0||S.dead>0||S.victory>0)return;S.hp--;S.invuln=1.15;playSom("JogadorDano");if(S.hp<=0){S.hp=0;S.dead=1.25;playSom("Derrota");setAnim("die",true);}else setAnim("hurt",true);}
function hitBoss(){S.bossHp--;S.flash=.14;playSom("BossAcerto");if(S.bossHp<=0){S.bossHp=0;S.victory=.85;playSom("BossMorte");setBossAnim("death");}}
function updatePlayer(dt){const p=S.player,acc=1600,max=300,grav=1500,jump=-650,left=down("KeyA")||down("ArrowLeft"),right=down("KeyD")||down("ArrowRight");if(left){p.vx-=acc*dt;p.face=-1;}if(right){p.vx+=acc*dt;p.face=1;}if(!left&&!right)p.vx*=Math.pow(.001,dt);p.vx=clamp(p.vx,-max,max);if((down("KeyW")||down("ArrowUp"))&&p.onGround){p.vy=jump;p.onGround=false;setAnim("jump",true);}p.vy=Math.min(1000,p.vy+grav*dt);const old=p.y;p.x=clamp(p.x+p.vx*dt,24,830);p.y+=p.vy*dt;p.onGround=false;if(p.vy>=0){for(const pl of platforms()){if(old<=pl.y+1&&p.y>=pl.y&&p.x>pl.x-12&&p.x<pl.x+pl.w+12){p.y=pl.y;p.vy=0;p.onGround=true;break;}}}if(p.y>520){damage();p.x=95;p.y=424;p.vx=0;p.vy=0;p.onGround=true;}}
function updateAnim(dt){const p=S.player,a=PANIM[p.anim];p.frameT+=dt;if(p.frameT>=1/a.fps){p.frameT-=1/a.fps;p.frame++;if(p.frame>=a.keys.length)p.frame=a.loop?0:a.keys.length-1;}}
function update(dt){S.t+=dt;const enter=pressed("Enter"),space=pressed("Space");
  if(S.screen==="start"){if(enter){S.phase=1;resetPhase();S.screen="jogo";playSom("Menu");startMusica();}}
  else if(S.screen==="vitoria"){if(!S.victorySom){S.victorySom=true;playSom("Vitoria");}if(enter){playSom("Menu");if(S.phase<5){S.phase++;resetPhase();S.screen="jogo";}else{S.phase=1;resetPhase();S.screen="start";}}}
  else if(S.screen==="derrota"){if(enter){playSom("Menu");resetPhase();S.screen="jogo";}}
  else if(S.screen==="jogo"){const b=cfg(),p=S.player;
    if(S.flash>0)S.flash-=dt;if(S.invuln>0)S.invuln-=dt;updatePlayer(dt);
    S.boss.x=clamp(S.boss.x+(p.x<S.boss.x?-1:1)*b.vel*dt,90,764);S.boss.y=b.y+Math.sin(S.t*2.1+S.phase)*10;
    if(space&&S.attack<=0&&S.dead<=0&&S.victory<=0){S.attackId++;S.attack=.42;S.attackAge=0;setAnim("attack",true);playSom("Ataque");}
    if(S.attack>0){S.attack-=dt;S.attackAge+=dt;if(S.attackAge>.06&&S.attackAge<.3&&S.lastHit!==S.attackId&&overlap(48,55)){S.lastHit=S.attackId;hitBoss();}}
    if(S.dead>0){S.dead-=dt;setAnim("die",false);if(S.dead<=0)S.screen="derrota";}
    else if(S.victory>0){S.victory-=dt;if(S.victory<=0)S.screen="vitoria";}
    else{if(S.invuln>0)setAnim("hurt",false);else if(S.attack>0)setAnim("attack",false);else if(!p.onGround)setAnim("jump",false);else if(down("KeyA")||down("KeyD")||down("ArrowLeft")||down("ArrowRight"))setAnim("run",false);else setAnim("idle",false);if(overlap(18,60))damage();}
    if(S.victory>0)setBossAnim("death");else if(S.flash>0)setBossAnim("hurt");else setBossAnim("walk");
    updateAnim(dt);updateBossAnim(dt);}
  for(const k in keys)prev[k]=keys[k];
}
function drawBG(){const im=A.fundo;if(im&&im.complete)ctx.drawImage(im,0,0,854,480);else{ctx.fillStyle="#141a28";ctx.fillRect(0,0,854,480);}ctx.fillStyle=BG[S.screen==="jogo"?S.phase-1:0];ctx.globalAlpha=.35;ctx.fillRect(0,0,854,480);ctx.globalAlpha=1;}
function drawPlatforms(){const im=A.plataforma;for(const pl of platforms()){for(let y=pl.y;y<pl.y+pl.h;y+=28)for(let x=pl.x;x<pl.x+pl.w;x+=80){if(im&&im.complete)ctx.drawImage(im,x,y,Math.min(80,pl.x+pl.w-x),Math.min(28,pl.y+pl.h-y));else{ctx.fillStyle="#4a5568";ctx.fillRect(x,y,80,28);}}}}
function drawPlayer(){const p=S.player,a=PANIM[p.anim],im=A[a.keys[p.frame]];if(!im||!im.complete)return;const w=55,h=69,blink=S.invuln>0&&Math.floor(S.t*18)%2===0;ctx.save();ctx.globalAlpha=blink?.35:1;if(p.face<0){ctx.translate(p.x,0);ctx.scale(-1,1);ctx.translate(-p.x,0);}ctx.drawImage(im,p.x-w/2,p.y-h,w,h);ctx.restore();}
function drawBoss(){const b=cfg(),k=b.obj+"_"+S.bossAnim+"_"+S.bossFrame,im=A[k]||A[b.obj+"_idle_0"];if(!im||!im.complete)return;ctx.save();ctx.globalAlpha=S.flash>0?.5:(S.victory>0?.65:1);ctx.translate(S.boss.x,S.boss.y);ctx.rotate(Math.sin(S.t*2.7)*.05);ctx.drawImage(im,-b.w/2,-b.h,b.w,b.h);ctx.restore();const by=S.boss.y-b.h-18;ctx.fillStyle="#ff5b5b";ctx.fillRect(S.boss.x-70,by,140,9);ctx.fillStyle="#54d6ff";ctx.fillRect(S.boss.x-70,by,140*(S.bossHp/10),9);ctx.strokeStyle="#dff4ff";ctx.strokeRect(S.boss.x-70,by,140,9);}
function drawText(t,x,y,s,c,al){ctx.font="bold "+s+"px Arial";ctx.textAlign=al||"left";ctx.textBaseline="top";ctx.fillStyle="#000a";ctx.fillText(t,x+2,y+2);ctx.fillStyle=c;ctx.fillText(t,x,y);}
function drawHUD(){drawText("FASE "+S.phase+"  |  "+cfg().nome+"  |  BOSS "+S.bossHp+"/10",16,12,18,"#fff","left");for(let i=0;i<3;i++){const im=A[i<S.hp?"cheio":"vazio"];if(im&&im.complete)ctx.drawImage(im,752+i*30,12,28,26);}drawText("A/D mover   W pular   ESPAÇO atacar",16,452,14,"#c9d6ff","left");}
function drawScreens(){if(S.screen==="start"){drawText("GALO PACÍFICO",427,125,52,"#ffd35c","center");drawText("AS CINCO FASES",427,188,34,"#fff","center");drawText("A/D mover   W pular   ESPAÇO atacar",427,290,20,"#c9d6ff","center");drawText("Pressione ENTER para começar",427,345,22,"#7dff9b","center");}
 else if(S.screen==="vitoria"){if(S.phase<5){drawText("FASE "+S.phase+" CONCLUÍDA!",427,130,44,"#7dff9b","center");drawText("Boss derrotado: "+cfg().nome,427,200,22,"#fff","center");drawText("Pressione ENTER para a Fase "+(S.phase+1),427,300,22,"#ffd35c","center");}else{drawText("CAMPEÃO!",427,130,56,"#ffd35c","center");drawText("Você derrotou os 5 bosses!",427,210,24,"#fff","center");drawText("Pressione ENTER para voltar ao início",427,300,20,"#7dff9b","center");}}
 else if(S.screen==="derrota"){drawText("VOCÊ MORREU",427,130,50,"#ff6b6b","center");drawText("Derrotado por "+cfg().nome,427,205,22,"#fff","center");drawText("Pressione ENTER para tentar de novo",427,300,22,"#ffd35c","center");}}
function draw(){drawBG();if(S.screen==="jogo"){drawPlatforms();drawBoss();drawPlayer();drawHUD();}else drawScreens();}
let last=performance.now();function loop(now){const dt=Math.min(.05,(now-last)/1000);last=now;if(!S.paused)update(dt);draw();requestAnimationFrame(loop);}requestAnimationFrame(loop);
window.addEventListener("keydown",e=>{if(["Space","ArrowUp","ArrowDown","ArrowLeft","ArrowRight","Enter"].includes(e.code))e.preventDefault();keys[e.code]=true;C.focus();});
window.addEventListener("keyup",e=>{keys[e.code]=false;});C.addEventListener("pointerdown",()=>C.focus());
window.__jogoHTML={S,keys,pause(v){S.paused=!!v;},step(dt){update(dt);draw();},setKey(k,v){keys[k]=!!v;},resetPhase,state(){return{screen:S.screen,phase:S.phase,hp:S.hp,bossHp:S.bossHp,anim:S.player.anim,bossAnim:S.bossAnim,bossName:cfg().nome};}};
</script>
</body>
</html>
